mapper.insert: INSERT INTO checkins (user_id, place_id, checked_in_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{placeId}, #{checkedInAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT p.place_id, p.name, p.category, p.address, p.image_url,
CASE WHEN c.checkin_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS acquired,
c.checked_in_at
FROM places p
LEFT JOIN checkins c ON p.place_id = c.place_id AND c.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY acquired DESC, c.checked_in_at DESC, p.place_id DESC
